entry.author: New Zealand Story
entry.summary:
This video introduces the FernMark Licence Programme, New Zealand’s official government accreditation for exporters wanting to build trust and drive preference in international markets.

It explains how the FernMark helps New Zealand businesses stand out globally by signalling authenticity, origin, and quality to customers and partners offshore.

The FernMark Licence gives approved exporters the right to use the FernMark, a trusted trademark used by New Zealand government agencies around the world. It helps protect the reputation of New Zealand products and services internationally.

Find out more: https://www.fernmark.nzstory.govt.nz/
